context: A retired professor explains evaluation processes to a student
purpose: Teach: 算定/暫定/安価/付与/除外/評議/総括/助教授

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 君も来年から評議会に参加するんだろう？まずは評価制度の総括から話そうか。
lines.en: You'll be joining the council next year, right? Let's start with an overview of the evaluation system.
lines.style: Warm mentoring tone, measured pace, gentle authority of a retired academic

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、お願いします。正直、成績の算定基準がいまだによく分からなくて。
lines.en: Yes, please. Honestly, I still don't really understand the grading criteria.
lines.style: Earnest student voice, slightly nervous, polite and curious

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うむ、各学部で違うんだ。私が助教授だった頃は、暫定の基準を毎年見直していたよ。
lines.en: Mm, it differs by faculty. When I was an associate professor, we revised the provisional standards every year.
lines.style: Reflective elder reminiscing, slower delivery, slight nostalgia in voice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 暫定っていうのは、正式には決まっていない、ということですか？
lines.en: By provisional, do you mean it wasn't officially finalized?
lines.style: Inquisitive follow-up, leaning in, genuine effort to understand

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: その通り。出席点や課題点を付与する割合も、教員の裁量で動いていた。
lines.en: Exactly. The ratio for awarding attendance and assignment points was also at the instructor's discretion.
lines.style: Patient explanatory cadence, illustrating with hands, professorial clarity

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ、欠席が多い学生を評価から除外することもあったんですか？
lines.en: So were there cases where students with many absences were excluded from evaluation?
lines.style: Slightly concerned, testing the limits of the rule, sincere curiosity

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: あったね。ただ、安価な参考書を一冊配って救済する先生もいたよ。優しい時代だった。
lines.en: Yes, there were. But some teachers handed out a cheap study guide to give students a second chance. Gentler times.
lines.style: Soft chuckle in voice, fond memory, warm closing tone with slight smile
